versions.content: If Nm_EnableCommunication is called with a network handle where NmPassiveModeEnabled is set to TRUE it shall not execute any functionality and return with E_NOT_OK . If NmDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE then it shall raise the error NM_E_INVALID_CHANNEL in this case.
